277576409.description:
Natural Trilobite Fossil
Stone Matrix Specimen
Paleozoic Era
This impressive trilobite fossil is preserved within its natural stone matrix, displaying the characteristic segmented exoskeleton of these ancient marine arthropods. The specimen features a well-defined thoracic region and cephalon, highlighted by a hand-tooled border prepared in the surrounding sedimentary stone to emphasize the fossil's biological form. As a representative of the Paleozoic Era, this piece offers a tangible connection to Earth's prehistoric oceans and early biological diversity.
Natural fossil specimen embedded in sedimentary stone matrix
Detailed thoracic segments and cephalon structure visible on the dorsal surface
Manually prepared border carved into the matrix to highlight the central specimen
Dimensions: 6.5" L x 6" W x 1" H; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fossil is structurally sound within the matrix with no visible structural repairs or artificial reconstructions. The stone matrix remains solid with natural mineral variations and ochre-toned oxidation consistent with geological aging. The reverse side exhibits natural stone textures and fossiliferous fragments.
